name: Verified Denmark five-leg route — 264.425 km selection

breakdown.official_layer: Local access roads, private connectors and conservative data gaps

inferred: Exact Google section distances were allocated in proportion to official matched-path classes.
Seven Google-labelled numbered-road sections totaling 235.387 km were matched to official E20, E47, Route 22, Route 14 and Route 21 paths.
Local sections were accepted only when official-network distance differed by no more than max(50 m, 5%) and both maneuver-anchor snaps were no more than 100 m.
Operational mapping: Highway = signed motorway; Country = non-motorway outside built-up-area signs; City = non-motorway inside built-up-area signs.
unresolved: 20.078 km of local access roads, private connectors and conservative official-network gaps were not assigned to another category.
The legal source does not prescribe a universal GIS mapping for every country's road attributes.
Google can change a shared link's selected route; this evidence package applies only to the recorded 264.425 km / 84-maneuver fingerprint.
method: The Google-selected route was read directly and its 84 maneuver distances reconciled to 264.425 km. Google-labelled numbered sections were restricted to their stated official route numbers and matched against the Vejman numbered-road network. The accepted official-path distance differences were between 0.08% and 0.48%, with official attribute joins no farther than 0.7 m. Reliable short sections used the max(50 m, 5%) distance and 100 m anchor-snap gates. Two unchanged Copenhagen motorway connectors totaling 1.256 km retained their prior identical-anchor official match. Every section that failed these conservative checks remains unresolved.
official_sources: Danish road and path register regulation: https://www.retsinformation.dk/api/pdf/177057
